summary: Add a global --account <name> flag for per-account config dirs; require explicit --yes (or --dry-run) for remote write endpoint commands and import; --agent no longer implies --yes.
reason: Sellers running two Amazon logins had to prefix every call with AMAZON_ADS_CONFIG. Separately, --agent silently granted --yes while no endpoint write checked it, so an agent could create, update, or delete campaigns with no confirmation step. Read-style POSTs (list, search, recommendations, forecasts, eligibility, report and snapshot requests, mcp:read-only) stay ungated.
validated_outcome: go build, go vet, go test ./... pass except the pre-existing Windows-only TestLoadReadsDotEnvBesideDefaultConfig failure (fails identically on main); every POST endpoint command's read/write classification hand-reviewed (84 gated, 86 read-style); verify_skill.py: 0 errors.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Printing Press >= 4.30.3 already emits --agent without --yes (cli-printing-press#4182); a reprint supersedes that part of this patch. The annotation-keyed write-confirmation gate remains CLI-specific.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: This CLI was printed under 4.18.1, before the generator fix.
